# Kian's wiki

> Agent-maintained knowledge base about Kian's people, projects, orgs, concepts, and decisions. Source of truth: the markdown files in this repo. Companion (read-only) to `~/obsidian/` which holds Kian's hand-written daily notes and self-command artifacts.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the contract — principles, frontmatter schema, write rules, off-limits
- [index.md](index.md): flat catalog of every page in the wiki
- [log.md](log.md): chronological append-only stream of changes

## Trees

- [people/](people/): one file per person Kian knows or follows closely
- [projects/](projects/): active and notable projects/repos
- [orgs/](orgs/): companies, labs, podcasts, vendors
- [concepts/](concepts/): technical, philosophical, operational ideas
- [decisions/](decisions/): explicit decisions Kian has made and why

## Agent infrastructure

- [_agent/corrections.md](_agent/corrections.md): accumulated lessons — load into every run prompt
- [_agent/entity-decisions.md](_agent/entity-decisions.md): alias resolution audit log
- [_agent/lint.md](_agent/lint.md): the lint spec; run at end of every ingest

## Companion sources (read-only)

- `/Users/kian/obsidian/` — human-written daily notes, plan, projection. The agent reads, never writes.
- `/Users/kian/.codex/memories/` — Codex's own distilled memory of Kian's work. Bootstrap source.
- `/Users/kian/.claude/projects/**/*.jsonl` — Claude Code session transcripts.
- `~/Library/Messages/chat.db` — iMessage SQLite (FDA required).
- Gmail + Calendar via MCP.
